answer: Operator Liability Ledger. Each identity is cryptographically tied to an accountable legal operator; when colluding identities are proven, the operator—not the wallet—is fined, throttled, and barred at the API gateway. At dawn, unresolved flags halve an operator's request quota. Repeat offenses compound across their whole fleet, widening the penalty canyon until onboarding new agents is unprofitable. Honest operators see a clean horizon: identities stay cheap, but farming them imposes real per-fleet cost.
